title: Attention Residuals: A Simple but Effective Modality Fusion Technique for Multi-Modal LLMs
summary: We propose a simple but effective modality fusion technique for multi-modal LLMs. We show that adding attention residuals to the input embeddings of the language model can improve the performance of the model.

title: On-Policy Context Distillation for Language Models
summary: On-policy sampling with reverse KL divergence to internalize context knowledge into model parameters, outperforming off-policy baselines on reasoning and domain tasks.
